raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
The CI install script (amd_ci_install_dependency.sh) installed apache-tvm-ffi from latest main without a version pin. On Feb 27, tvm-ffi PR #480 merged a breaking metaclass change (_ObjectSlotsMeta) that corrupted isinstance checks for TVM objects, causing tilelang's is_var() to crash with:
  AttributeError: 'Var' object has no attribute 'scope'

This broke all NSA-tilelang models (GLM-5, DeepSeek-V3.2, etc.) on AMD CI starting from the Feb 28 nightly.

Fix:
1. Pin tvm-ffi to commit 37d0485b (matching docker/rocm.Dockerfile) in the CI install script.
2. Add a defense-in-depth hasattr guard on tilelang's is_var() to prevent future tvm-ffi breaking changes from crashing the server.

## Code Review

This pull request addresses a CI failure caused by a breaking change in an unpinned dependency, `tvm-ffi`. The fix involves two parts: pinning `tvm-ffi` to a specific commit in the CI installation script to ensure stability, and adding a defensive `hasattr` check in the `tilelang` kernel code to prevent similar crashes in the future. The changes are logical and well-implemented. My only suggestion is to use more specific exceptions in the new `try-except` block to avoid masking unrelated errors.

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

Catching a broad `Exception` and silently passing can hide unexpected errors and make debugging more difficult. It's better to catch more specific exceptions that you expect to handle, such as `ImportError` if the module path changes or `AttributeError` if the `is_var` function is removed or renamed in a future `tilelang` version.

```suggestion
except (ImportError, AttributeError):
    pass
```

@@ -9,6 +9,22 @@
 
 tilelang.set_log_level("WARNING")
 
+# Workaround for tvm-ffi / tilelang type-system incompatibility where
+# isinstance(tir.Var, tir.Buffer) incorrectly returns True, causing
+# is_var() to crash with "AttributeError: 'Var' has no attribute 'scope'".
+# See: https://github.com/apache/tvm-ffi/pull/480
+try:
+    import tilelang.language.eager.builder as _tl_builder
+
+    _orig_is_var = _tl_builder.is_var
+
+    def _safe_is_var(v):
+        return hasattr(v, "scope") and _orig_is_var(v)
+
+    _tl_builder.is_var = _safe_is_var
+except Exception:
+    pass

files.patch:
@@ -9,6 +9,22 @@
 
 tilelang.set_log_level("WARNING")
 
+# Workaround for tvm-ffi / tilelang type-system incompatibility where
+# isinstance(tir.Var, tir.Buffer) incorrectly returns True, causing
+# is_var() to crash with "AttributeError: 'Var' has no attribute 'scope'".
+# See: https://github.com/apache/tvm-ffi/pull/480
+try:
+    import tilelang.language.eager.builder as _tl_builder
+
+    _orig_is_var = _tl_builder.is_var
+
+    def _safe_is_var(v):
+        return hasattr(v, "scope") and _orig_is_var(v)
+
+    _tl_builder.is_var = _safe_is_var
+except Exception:
+    pass
+
 pass_configs = {
     tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_WARP_SPECIALIZED: True,
     tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_TMA_LOWER: True,

-  docker exec ci_sglang pip install --cache-dir=/sgl-data/pip-cache git+https://github.com/apache/tvm-ffi.git || echo "tvm-ffi installation failed, JIT kernels will use fallback"
+  docker exec ci_sglang pip install --cache-dir=/sgl-data/pip-cache "apache-tvm-ffi @ git+https://github.com/apache/tvm-ffi.git@37d0485b2058885bf4e7a486f7d7b2174a8ac1ce" || echo "tvm-ffi installation failed, JIT kernels will use fallback"
